rationale: Exus Renewables North America is a standalone North American renewable IPP, developer and operator under Exus North America Holdings, LLC, distinct from Exus's legally separate overseas advisory operations. Partners Group invested on October 3, 2023 through Exus US Holdings, LP and remains active alongside retained founders and management.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical Exus Renewables North America company with Exus North America Holdings, LLC as legal parent context.
Add Partners Group as an active owner from 2023-10-03 through Exus US Holdings, LP without inventing a stake percentage or fund allocation.
Record founders and management as retained active co-owners without inventing a split.
Exclude overseas Exus businesses, projects, mandates and financing SPVs from separate counting.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact Partners Group stake, governance, client-vehicle stack and founder split are not publicly disclosed.
The intermediate chain among Exus Partners Holding, Exus US Holdings and Exus North America Holdings is not public.
2023-10-03 is the best public close date; no separate closing release was found.
